name: Hermit
summary: A hermit is a recluse who gained her oracular powers from isolation in a deep desert, on a mountain peak, or in another secluded location.

features.name: Reclusive Curse
features.summary: The Hermit gains the Reclusive curse at 1st level.

features.name: Reclusive Spellcasting
features.summary: In combat, allies must hit with a melee touch attack to affect you with touch spells, and you attempt saves against spells cast by anyone else. Instantaneous spells you cast solely on yourself resolve at +1 caster level. At curse level 5, self-only casts gain Extend Spell without spending a higher slot or taking longer to cast.

features.name: Bonus Spells
features.summary: Blindness/deafness (4th), crushing despair (8th), wall of force (12th), maze (16th). These bonus spells replace the oracle’s normal mystery bonus spells at these levels.

features.name: Recluse’s Stride (Su)
features.summary: Your base speed increases by 10 feet. At 10th level, teleport a distance equal to your base land speed as a move action while isolated, up to 3 + Charisma modifier times per day.

resourceActions.label: Teleport with Recluse’s Stride

confirmations.label: No other creature is within 10 feet of me or my destination

resourceActions.summary: Teleport a distance equal to your base land speed as with dimension door.

features.name: Recluse’s Stride — Unthreatened Step
features.summary: Once per round when leaving a square, treat it as unthreatened by opponents you can see.

features.name: Fade from Memory (Su)
features.summary: If no creatures are within 10 feet at the end of your turn, activate Fade from Memory as a free action. Attacks against you have a 20% miss chance until your next turn, rising to 50% at 14th oracle level. Daily uses equal your oracle level.

resourceActions.label: Activate Fade from Memory

confirmations.label: No creature is within 10 feet at the end of my turn

activeEffect.name: Fade from Memory
activeEffect.description: Concealment until the beginning of your next turn.

resourceActions.summary: Apply concealment until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Reclusive Defenses
features.summary: At curse level 10, charm spells and spell-like abilities cannot affect you. At curse level 15, spell resistance is 10 plus your oracle level.

featureOverrides.summary: Choose a mystery that grants Survival as a class skill.

mechanicalNotes: The Reclusive curse is fixed, legal mysteries are selectable, and Fade from Memory and Recluse’s Stride uses are tracked. Individual spell targets, the curse’s self-cast modifiers, and threatened squares are adjudicated at the table.
